articles.headline: World Cup live updates: United States takes on Belgium in last 16
articles.description: Enjoy all the updates from Monday's 2026 World Cup round-of-16 match between the United States and Belgium.

articles.headline: Ronaldo's World Cup career ends with a whimper as Spain's subs win it late
articles.description: Spain's late winner knocked out Portugal and closed the book on Cristiano Ronaldo's time on the world's biggest stage.

articles.headline: Cristiano Ronaldo exits final World Cup with 'clear conscience'
articles.description: An emotional Cristiano Ronaldo said he had a "clear conscience" as he exited his final World Cup as Portugal were eliminated 1-0 by Spain in the round of 16 in Arlington, Texas, on Monday.

articles.headline: Roberto Martinez steps down, says Portugal 'didn't fail'
articles.description: Roberto Martinez confirmed that he is leaving his job as Portugal coach after Monday's 1-0 World Cup round-of-16 defeat to Spain, while denying that the result was "a failure."

articles.headline: Folarin Balogun named in starting XI for U.S. vs. Belgium
articles.description: Mauricio Pochettino put Folarin Balogun in the starting lineup for the United States in its round-of-16 match with Belgium in the FIFA World Cup on Monday in Seattle.
